notes.title: Some Minor Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Happy Friday :) While plugging away at the iOS build, I came across some minor things that needed some fixing:

+ Fixed scene selection issue if you clicked ACT 3 Scene 1, the scene wouldn't start.

+ Title screen is now re-centered? Don't even ask me how it got messed up in the first place....

+ Most clickable room objects now do a little bouncy bounce when clicked.

+ Added a few lines of dialogue to the rotating painting puzzle in Paige & Finley's studio scene to let players know they need to click the painting. 

Have a good weekend!
